response.text:
I can help, but this will change calendar state (destructive). Before I proceed I need a few clarifications and your explicit confirmation.

Please answer these:

1) Exact date range — what do you mean by “next week”?
   - Option A: the next calendar week (Monday through Sunday) — give the week start date if you prefer a different locale.
   - Option B: the next 7 days from today.
   - Tell me which you want and your time zone (so day boundaries are correct).

2) Scope — which events should be removed?
   - All events on your calendar (including personal items and blocked time).
   - Only meetings (events with other attendees).
   - Only events on a specific calendar (e.g., “Work”, “Personal”) — name the calendar(s).

3) Recurring events — how to handle series?
   - Remove only occurrences in that date range.
   - Cancel the entire recurring series.

4) Notification to attendees:
   - Send cancellations/declines to attendees (recommended for meetings with others).
   - Remove from your calendar without notifying attendees (may be confusing to others).
   - Decline but keep the event so others see you declined.

5) Deletion vs. decline vs. cancel:
   - Delete (remove event from calendar; if attendees exist, you can optionally send a cancellation).
   - Decline (keeps the event but marks you as not attending).
   - Cancel (if you are the organizer, cancels the event for all attendees).

6) Which calendar account (if multiple) should I act on? Provide account name or email.

7) Any exceptions? (e.g., keep 1:1s with a specific person, keep XYZ meeting)

When you reply, please state your choices and include an explicit confirmation phrase such as:
"Confirm: delete all meetings (only events with attendees) from my Work calendar for next calendar week (Mon–Sun, timezone: PST). Send cancellations to attendees. Remove only occurrences, not series."

After I receive those details and confirmation I will proceed (or, if you prefer, I can draft the cancellation message(s) first for your review). I cannot perform background work unless you confirm and I have calendar access — tell me if you want me to proceed now.
